The Remraam community in Dubai features two sought-after clusters: Al Thamam Remraam Dubai and Al Ramth. Both areas attract significant interest from renters and buyers.

Al Ramth offers a similar appeal. One-bedroom apartments for rent are priced between AED 50k and AED 80k, while sales prices for two-bedroom units range from AED 875k to AED 2M.

The Remraam al Thamam Dubai location lies within Dubailand along Emirates Road, offering quick access to Dubai South and Al Maktoum International Airport.
